globalCaveats: The current engine still uses legacy baseWaterMm, kc and ordinal nitrogen/market/forage/heat assumptions; do not call its rankings FAO-validated.
FAO tabulated Kc coefficients need crop-stage dates and local climatic adjustments; no Egypt-specific calendar is inferred here.
Salt thresholds use laboratory measured soil ECe in dS/m, not the app's 0–100 screening proxy.
Do not convert qualitative sesame salinity into a numerical threshold.
Cowpea short-cover performance and forage salinity studies are not interchangeable.
